g.text: Home win or skip: square-root-profit weighting
Compare home win with away-or-draw using probability x sqrt(decimal odds - 1).
Bet one unit only if home wins the comparison (including ties); otherwise stake zero.

g.text: Home bets pay B365H - 1 on a home win, lose 1 on a draw or away win. Skipped matches pay 0.
Away-or-draw odds are a synthetic comparison price only; no hedge is placed. Exploratory backtest.
